entries.title: Zero External Runtime Dependencies
entries.content: All CLI utilities must use Python 3.10+ standard library only; no third-party pip packages allowed.

entries.title: Windows Path Compatibility
entries.content: Use pathlib.Path everywhere and avoid POSIX-only shell assumptions.

entries.title: Implement Atomic File Persistence
entries.content: Ensure all JSON and Markdown writes use tempfile + os.fsync + os.replace.

entries.title: Concise Diff Summaries
entries.content: Always run dry-run previews before modifying shared project rule files.
